mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with meprobamate (CNS depressant) produces additive CNS depression and potential serotonergic effects; meprobamate may inhibit MAOI metabolism, increasing toxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if meprobamate is necessary, use lowest dose with close monitoring for excessive sedation, hypotension, and serotonin syndrome symptoms.
